xbrli:xbrl.in-capmkt:StatusOfTheLitigationDisputeAs:
Received order under Section 143(3) r.w.s. 144B alongwith Notice of demand of INR 1,164.77 crore under section 156 of the Income-Tax Act, 1961 for the AY 2022-23. The order mainly contains income reported by the company in its return of income and the details of income assessed by the assessing officer. The order has made addition to taxable income on account of allowance claimed by assessee on ESOP expense and subcontractor expenses paid to overseas associated enterprises without deduction of tax at source. The case was pending with Assessment Unit, Income Tax Department.
Subsequently, the Company received a rectification Order dated July 7, 2025, under section 154 of the Income Tax Act, 1961 on 8 July 2025. Pursuant to this Order, the tax demand has been reduced from INR 1,164.77 crore to INR 582.7 crore, resulting in a net reduction of ₹582.07 crore. The same has been intimated to both the Stock Exchanges on July 9, 2025.
xbrli:xbrl.in-capmkt:CurrentStatusOfTheLitigationOr: The original order for INR 1164.77 Cr was challenged in Karnataka High Court and the entire assessment order together with notice of Demand has been set aside and directing the matter back to the Assessing Officer (AO) for fresh consideration. Accordingly, the related tax demand of INR 582.7 crore has also been automatically vacated
xbrli:xbrl.in-capmkt:NameOfTheOpposingParty: Office of the DCIT, International tax, Circle 1(1), Bangalore Income Tax Department
xbrli:xbrl.in-capmkt:StatusOfTheLitigationDisputeAs:
Received order under Section Sec 201 and Sec 201(1A) alongwith Notice of demand of INR 232.37 crore under section 156 of the Income-Tax Act, 1961 for AY 2018-2019 & AY 2019-20 20. The order mainly contains demand of TDS on overseas payments to foreign associated Enterprises and interest thereon. The order has created demand on tax deductible at source on payment of subcontracting charges to overseas subsidiaries and Associated Enterprises. The case is pending with Office of the DCIT, International tax, Circle 1(1), Bangalore Income Tax Department.
Subsequently, the Company has received a rectification Order under Section 154 of the Income Tax Act, 1961 dated September 26, 2025. Pursuant to this order, the tax demand has been reduced from INR 232.37 crore to INR 108.56 crore, resulting in a net reduction of INR 123.82 crore. The same has been intimated to both the Stock Exchanges on September 27, 2025.
xbrli:xbrl.in-capmkt:CurrentStatusOfTheLitigationOr: Appeal has been filed before CIT(A), Guwahati and matter is sub judice.
